name: Hello Tome (C++)
description: The hello example written in C++ with tome/tome.hpp: JASS natives, a main menu button, game events, a hook, a /hellocpp chat command, settings, a keybind (Ctrl+Shift+J) and a popup.
natives: native HelloCppLog takes integer value returns nothing
native HelloCppDouble takes real value returns real
native HelloCppGreet takes string name returns string
native HelloCppCall takes code callback returns boolean
